programme.desc: A Sash and a Rash/Fish Out of Water: Chloe thinks she has a stress-caused rash and wishes to be a slacker, but Dimmsdale falls apart without her. Dad wants to catch a giant fish to win a trophy, but Chloe wishes all the fish could fight back.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Animal Crockers/One Flu Over the Crocker’s Nest: Chloe wishes that an animal that looks like Mr. Crocker would no longer be endangered. Timmy, Chloe and the fairies go inside Mr. Crocker to destroy the magical Fairy Flu germs Cosmo sneezed on him.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Booby Trapped: Cosmo and Wanda spend the night at Chloe’s, disguised as Flightless Booby Birds. But when Chloe’s parents decide to return the boobies to their natural habitat in the rainforest, Timmy and Chloe have to go and save them.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: Blue Angel/Marked Man: Chloe’s goodness is draining the Anti-Fairy World Wand. Foop disguises himself as a girl to try and break Chloe. Timmy takes Chloe to meet Mark Chang to prove to her that aliens really do exist.
